title: Reassemble an electric carving knife: join the blades by rivet and keyhole, then click both into the handle
instruction: Put the carving knife's two blades back together and click them into the handle.
context: An electric carving knife's blades are separated for washing and must be rejoined before every use: the rivet on one blade goes into the keyhole slot of the other, then the pair slides into the motor handle until both blades click. A blade left unlatched, or the pair unjoined, comes loose while carving.
setup: Cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left); heights above the table. Two stainless steel serrated blades, loose, 48 g each: 26.5 long, 0.12 thick, 2.2 wide at the guard tapering to 1.4; a 3.5 long, 1.2 wide tail with an 11.5 x 6 mm latch window; a black nylon grease guard 3.6 x 1.4 x 0.6 at 3.5 to 4.9 from the tail end. Blade A: guard underneath, a steel rivet (2 mm shank, 5 mm head) on its top face 25.0 from the tail end; tail end at x 18, y 2, tip toward +y. Blade B: guard on top, keyhole 7 mm round at 24.5 from the tail end with a 3 mm slot running 6 mm toward the tip; tail end at x 27, y 3.5, tip toward +y. Power handle, loose, white plastic, 550 g, unplugged, lying on its side: 21.5 long, 6.8 deep, 5.0 thick, the front 6 cm a nose 2.8 deep and 3.4 thick holding the blade socket (4 x 13 mm, 4 cm deep, centre 2.5 high); mouth at x 30, y -3, facing +y, body toward -y. Inside, two sprung steel latch lips (4 x 4.4 mm, 1.9 mm into the socket), one from above and one from below, 2.35 to 2.75 deep, sprung at 1.5 N, 4.4 N fully lifted. Distractors (ignored by scoring): green kitchen sponge 7.1 x 10.1 x 3.3, 20 g, at x 50, y -20; red ceramic mug 11.4 x 9.0 x 8.0, 300 g, at x 50, y 24.
scoring: Read every step from poses. Joined: A's rivet in B's narrow slot (3.5 to 6.5 mm past the keyhole's centre toward the tip, within 2 mm of the slot centre line), the blades face to face within 0.6 mm and parallel within 4 deg. A blade latched: its lip within 0.35 mm of its rest stop (down in the window), its guard within 1.5 mm of the mouth, and its tail end inside the socket, within 2 mm of its centre line. Full: joined, both latched, all parts under 1 cm/s and 0.2 rad/s, every fingertip over 4 cm from both guards and the mouth, held 2 s; once reached it stays 1.0. Otherwise the end score is 0.25 for joined plus 0.25 per latched blade (max 0.75). 0 if any part ever falls more than 5 cm below the table top, even after full.
reset_notes: Press the handle's release button and pull the blades out, slide the rivet back to the round end of the keyhole and lift B off, then lay the blades and handle on taped outlines at their marks (B guard up, A guard down, both tips toward +y). Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Full size and mass. Blades, guards and handle are rigid convex pieces (keyhole drawn round, colliding as an octagon; serrations drawn). Motor, cord and release button not simulated. The latch cam is a rule: each sprung lip lifts while its tail passes and drops into the tail's window, then blocks pull-out; the cam's insertion force is not modelled. Socket play 0.8 mm a side. Friction 0.45. Sponge and mug are SimReady; the knife is custom. No force sensing.
